Container.Name: chainlink-postgresql
Container.Overview: PostgreSQL 17 for ChainLink Server, reachable only through Docker networks unless separately exposed. Create chainlink_net and the password file before installation. No database ports are published. Initialization variables affect a new, empty data directory only; preserve existing data paths, PGDATA, and credentials when adopting an existing database.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL data
Config.Description: Persistent PostgreSQL 17 data. For an existing installation, retain its actual storage mapping and PGDATA.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL password file
Config.Description: Existing regular file containing only the database password; read-only mount. Create it before starting the container.

Config.Name: POSTGRES_DB
Config.Description: Database to create on first initialization. Match DATABASE_URL; retain the existing name when adopting a database.

Config.Name: POSTGRES_USER
Config.Description: Initial database owner. Match DATABASE_URL; retain the existing role when adopting a database.

Config.Name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD_FILE
Config.Description: Container path of the mounted password file. If changed, update the mount target too. Do not also set POSTGRES_PASSWORD.

Config.Name: PGDATA
Config.Description: Data directory inside the persistent mount. Keep the actual existing PGDATA when adopting a database.
